verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs say it can "confirm account ownership and customer details", and its Data API returns "account details" for consumer, business and corporate accounts. That is a first-party capability aimed at matching account owners. However, no evidence lists which holder fields are returned (names, addresses, contact data), so the depth of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific account-holder fields (name, postal address, email/phone), an identity/party endpoint reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: Confirm account ownership and customer details instantly.
access your customers' financial data including account balances, transaction history and account details
This includes if your customer has a consumer, business or corporate account.
